_doc: Picture/sound contract for hole-through-earth. 30 fps. Frames come from voice/words.json (word start frames). Visual reactions land 0-3 frames BEFORE their word. Shot boundaries and event frames are LOCKED: picture and sound are built in parallel from this file.

places.shaft: inside the tunnel: round rock tube, painted wall texture streaking past, colour by depth (crust brown -> mantle red/orange -> core white-yellow glow), speed-line cards
places.garden: Gus's back garden in the town: lawn, plank fence, backs of houses, trees/bushes/flowers, the HOLE (dark disc, stone rim) with a big dirt mound and a shovel
places.earth: cartoon Earth cutaway floating in space: layered half-globe (crust, mantle, outer core, inner core), straight tunnel through the centre, tiny Gus, 2D arrow cards, stars
places.park: the town park swing at golden hour (already in the skill template): adult pushes kid on a swing
places.ocean: open ocean at NIGHT on the far side of the world: moon, stars, a pipe rim sticking out of the waves (the far mouth of the tunnel), a fisherman in a rowboat with a lantern

shots.what: HOOK. Camera falls with Gus (fishbowl helmet, pyjamas, slippers), arms and legs flailing, walls streaking up past him. On 'never hit the bottom' (f96-105) the camera tilts down past him to the endless glowing tunnel. 4-frame white flash at 118.
Glide over the fence into the garden: Gus stands proudly by the hole, plants the shovel in the dirt mound on 'dug' (f181). Sunday-morning calm: birds, washing line.
'straight through the planet': hard cut to the Earth cutaway; the tunnel line punches through and a tiny flag pops out of the far side on 'planet' (f247).
Neighbor leans over the fence laughing and pointing, holding a grill fork; the sausage on it bursts into flame on 'burn' (f287) and is a black crisp by 'crisp' (f305).
Wife, deadpan, arms crossed, frying pan in hand; she flips a pancake that lands SPLAT on the lawn on 'splat' (f351).
Gus holds up a clipboard full of scribbled sums on 'math' (f412), salutes, and hops into the hole on 'jumps' (f429). Camera tilts down after him.
Falling through brown crust rock. No air: a white feather falls right beside him at exactly his speed (drifts into frame f504 on 'slows'); he looks at it, impressed.
A bullet is travelling down the tunnel; Gus slides past it from behind and overtakes it on 'outrunning' (f564), gives it a little wave on 'bullet' (f581).
Walls turn red then orange, streaks lengthen, his cheeks and pyjamas flap. Kick on 'shoots' (f633).
Insert: Earth cutaway, tiny Gus streaks through the white-hot core with a speed trail on 'center of the Earth' (f654-673).
Close-up on his face inside the helmet, everything white-yellow, maximum speed lines on 'twenty-two thousand miles an hour'. Kick on 'hour' (f727).
Glowing white-hot walls. He holds out a thermometer: it shoots to the top and pops on 'Sun' (f801). Then on 'very good tunnel' he calmly gives a thumbs-up (f836).
'But wait': hard cut to the quiet garden. Wife and neighbor lean over the hole, hands to their ears, waiting for the splat. A '?' fx card pops over the hole on 'splat?' (f897).

EXPLANATION (night-blue). Earth cutaway, slow push-in. Gus falls toward the centre; an arrow card from Gus to the centre pops on 'pulls' (f950). He crosses the centre on 'passes' (f1022): the arrow flips to point BACK at the centre. He visibly slows on 'slowing him down' (f1091-1109) as he climbs to the far side.
The swing analogy: adult pushes kid on 'pushed' (f1126); the swing whooshes fast through the bottom on 'going down' (f1215) and slows to a dead stop at the top of the arc on 'back up' (f1258).

Night ocean, moon. A fisherman in a rowboat dozes beside a pipe sticking out of the sea. On 'pops up' (f1342) Gus rises out of the pipe, slower and slower, and hangs perfectly still at the top on 'stops' (f1442). Fisherman's eyes go wide.
'Luckily': close two-shot. Gus, hovering, relieved, waves hello on 'stops' (f1482). The fisherman slowly waves back.

'Unluckily': same framing. Gus's smile drops as he starts to sink (f1560); he reaches for the fisherman's hand, misses, and drops back into the pipe on 'moment' (f1598). The fisherman is left mid-wave.
'Then down he goes again': fast shaft streak the other way, Gus falling with arms folded, bored. Colours run mantle -> core -> mantle -> crust (time-lapse).
Evening garden. Gus pops up out of the hole on 'back' (f1711) and hangs at the top on 'garden' (f1737). Wife looks up from a deck chair.

PAYOFF. He drops back in on 'never' (f1766). Wife winds an egg timer and holds out a sandwich on a plate. On 'home' (f1834) he pops up again, takes one bite on 'second' (f1855), and drops again on 'every' (f1877). Neighbor stares over the fence, jaw dropped, his forgotten sausage on fire (f1905). Ends on the last word.

events.note: white flash, music starts (playful Sunday theme)
shovel planted in the dirt mound
tunnel rush, pitch and level rising steadily to f743, holds to 861 (no air joke: keep it a stylised whoosh, not realistic wind)
streak through the core (Earth cutaway insert)
'But wait': rush and music cut dead
arrow flips as he passes the centre
rope creak in rhythm with the swing
Gus pops out of the pipe
he stops dead; music holds its breath
pops up in his own garden
the timer rings exactly as he arrives
